title: Nucleic Acid Purification Protocol for OT-2 Liquid Handling System
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Mix lysate with beads
steps.instruction: Pipette‑mix lysate, binding buffer, and magnetic beads in each well of the 2 mL block for approximately 10 minutes.

steps.title: Bind nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 10 minutes to allow beads to collect.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant from each sample well and discard it into the liquid‑waste reservoir.

steps.title: Wash beads three times
steps.instruction: Perform three successive wash cycles using 500 µL wash buffer per well.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL wash buffer from the 195 mL reservoir to each well of the 2 mL block.
Pipette‑mix each well to resuspend the beads.
Engage the magnetic module for 5 minutes.
Aspirate and discard 500 µL wash buffer from each well into the liquid‑waste reservoir.
Repeat the four substeps two additional times for a total of three washes.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Allow the beads to air‑dry on the magnetic module for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL elution buffer from the 12‑column reservoir to each well of the 2 mL block.

steps.title: Mix for elution
steps.instruction: Pipette‑mix the beads in each well for 5 minutes to release DNA into the elution buffer.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 2 minutes, then transfer the 50 µL eluate from each well to the corresponding well of a 96‑well skirted PCR plate (magnetic extraction plate in slot 6 maps directly to PCR plate in slot 3: A1→A1, B1→B1, …, D2→D2).
